people.imagined: The Tùng Hạ road at dawn, bareheaded in the cold. His father's axe is across his back, the wolf's bite long healed from his ear, and he is looking at the pines that will not take him.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pine-lined road at dawn, he turns his bareheaded face toward the viewer, an axe haft rising behind his shoulder. Face: most important, the ear: the top third of his left ear is simply gone, a healed, jagged pink-white stump with a clean notch, visible and large in the frame. A broad, sun-dark, square face; heavy straight brows; steady, honest, dark-brown eyes; a wide nose; a firm mouth; a day's stubble. Fine lines crease the skin at his eyes from squinting at snow-glare. Hair: black, thick and cropped short, never covered. Body: huge shoulders and thick neck, a woodcutter's frame, planted. Clothing: a vest of pine bark laced over elk hide with three visible rows of stitched repairs, over a rough brown linen shirt with the sleeves cut short; a leather strap crossing the chest; forearms bare and thick. Hands and objects: the long haft of a felling axe with a pale pine haft and a wolf's tooth set in it, rising over the right shoulder; his left hand on the strap. Background: dark pines, mist and a low red sun. Low frost lies on the road and a thin ribbon of smoke rises from far off between the trunks. Light: low gold light from the upper left. Expression: a steady, proud, unbowed look with the jaw squared, a man looking at the pines that will not take him; a faint green and grey-gold hint of wood and metal qi.

people.imagined: Noon on the frost coast, in the doorway of a dug-out dead hall. She talks to the lamp more than to her crew; the bronze lamp burns even in full daylight.
people.subject: The moment: in the bright mouth of a ruin she lifts a small green bronze lamp toward her face and murmurs to it, ignoring the viewer. Face: most important, the lit lamp: an old green-bronze temple lamp with a small steady flame burning in full daylight, held up beside her cheek, big in the frame. A small, wrinkled, grey, wind-polished face; narrow, light, shrewd eyes; thin grey brows; a hooked nose; thin lips shaping words. Wind has polished the skin to a thin leathery shine and her nose is red. Hair: iron grey, cut short, under a fur hood. Body: small and square, wrapped up. Clothing: a seal-fur coat joined from three different coats (one dark, one grey, one speckled) with neat even seams; a quilted silk collar showing; grey wool mittens with the fingers cut off; a rope belt with an iron seal-key. Hands and objects: the lamp in the left hand; a toothed brass key-like seal in the right. Her fingers are stiff and chapped at the knuckles. Background: a blue-white ice wall, a dark opening, tools and a rope. Light: harsh white daylight from the upper left, a small warm gold flame. Expression: a patient, wary, greedy attention, the shrewd eyes fixed on the lamp's flame as she murmurs; a faint blue hint of water qi and a faint gold glow around the flame.

people.imagined: The Bobtail ridge, mid-winter. The chief sits with an axe hafted in lynx bone across his knees. The lynx cap with its bob tail left on is the camp's badge, and he is thinking of his sworn brother in the south.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a ridge rock, a long-armed old man rests both wrists on the shaft of an axe, and looks at the viewer sideways. Face: most important, the cap: a lynx-skin cap with ear tufts and the short bob of the tail left hanging down the back, grey-spotted fur, big at the top of the frame. A lean, long, hard, weathered face; narrow, pale-grey, calm eyes; thick grey brows; a long hooked nose; a grey stubble; deep lines from nose to mouth. Frost whitens the tips of his brows and stubble. Hair: grey, long, under the cap, tied at the nape. Body: tall, gaunt, long-armed, hunched. Clothing: a lynx-pelt armour of spotted grey fur over iron rings, the rings from old mail; a heavy brown wool coat; a belt with a notched iron ring (nine notches) hanging; fur-lined gloves. Hands and objects: an axe with a pale bone haft (lynx shin bone) across his knees, both hands resting on it. Background: a bare ridge with snow and dark pine, a thin wisp of camp smoke. Snow-laden pine boughs frame the ridge and a few grey crows perch on a far rock. Light: cold white light from the upper left. Expression: a pragmatic, loyal, grim look from under heavy brows, an old chief thinking of his sworn brother in the south; a faint green and grey-gold hint of wood and metal qi.

people.imagined: The ruin crew's ice cut. She holds her bare palm flat on the ice and a hole sinks in with steam; her cheeks bear the old frost-burn from the winter the village tried to cool her in the lake.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on blue ice she presses her bare palm flat against it, steam rising, and looks up. Face: most important, the frost-burn marks: pale waxy blotches on both cheeks, shiny and mottled, in contrast to flushed red lips and warm skin, and the steam rising from her hand. A thin, narrow, pale-pink face; bright, hot, hazel eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; chapped lips parted. Melt-water beads on her lashes. Hair: dark brown, hacked short at the jaw, uneven and slightly singed at the ends. Body: thin, wiry, crouched. Her shoulders are narrow and her knees are drawn tight under her. Clothing: a quilted padded jacket in dull brown with the sleeves pushed to the elbow; a wool scarf; leggings; boots; a small glass bead on a cord at the neck glowing orange. Hands and objects: the bare, chapped, red hand on the ice with steam and a round melted hole beneath it; beside her a small copper brazier with glowing coals. Background: a wall of blue ice, a dug passage, coiled rope. Light: orange glow from the brazier and bead on the lower right, cold blue from the upper left. Expression: an impatient, brave, trusting look, the hot hazel eyes bright and the chapped lips parted; a clear hot red-orange hint of fire qi around the hand.

people.imagined: The caravan yard at Tùng Hạ Thị, early. She is tall, and the staff is worn white at the grip; she tests the bow's string with a thumb. The boy she taught is somewhere in the pines.
people.subject: The moment: standing tall in a yard, she tests the string of a long bow with her thumb while looking down at the viewer. Face: most important, the white staff and the bow: a long bow of pale yellow wood in her left hand with the string drawn across her thumb, and a staff worn white at the grip leaning against her shoulder. A long, handsome, angular face; high cheekbones; sharp grey eyes under straight brows; a straight nose; a stern mouth; a few fine lines. Hair: black streaked grey, in a long braid pinned round the head. Body: tall, strong, long-limbed, rangy. She stands with her weight on her left leg, one shoulder lower, completely at ease. Clothing: a dark green wool riding coat with a high collar, plain, well kept; a leather jerkin; a quiver of grey-fletched arrows over the back; leather gloves; a belt with a coin purse. Hands and objects: the bow; the staff. The bow's string is a plain twisted gut with a bone nock, and the white staff has a band of braided leather at the grip. Background: caravan wagons and mules, pine-board gates, a pale sky. Light: soft clear morning light from the upper left. A pale sun glints on the polished arrow tips in the quiver behind her shoulder. Expression: A cool, appraising look down at the viewer, brows level, the mouth firm and stubborn, her eyes measuring them as she tests the string. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: The river mouth at midnight. He poles without a lantern and has never been seen to hurry; he remembers no one's face, as the trade requires.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a narrow boat at night poling slowly, he turns his hooded face toward the viewer without any expression. Face: most important, the reed cape: a thick shaggy rain cape of dried grey-brown reeds covering his shoulders and back like a haystack, with a reed hat shading his face. A long, stooped, plain, pale face half in shadow; deep-set, dull, grey eyes with no curiosity; thin grey brows; a flat nose; a closed, slack mouth; grey stubble. Hair: grey under the hat. Body: tall, stooped, slow. He bends slightly at the waist at each push of the pole, and his long arms hang below the cape. Clothing: the reed cape; a brown hemp coat tied with a rope; bare forearms; trousers rolled; no lantern. Hands and objects: a long wooden pole held in both hands; a dark, narrow boat. The pole is dark with wet to a hand above his grip, and the boat's gunwale is low, with a flat grey stern nearly level with the water. Background: a black river, grey reeds, a faint pale moon. Light: pale blue moonlight from the upper left, no other light. Only the water carries light, a faint ripple edge, and his eyes are two dull points in the hat's shadow. Expression: A blank, calm face with half-lidded eyes and no expression at all, nothing in it to remember. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The dice house on the Hàn Tân quay, lamplit. She counts debts and gossip. A pearl in each ear, one real and one glass, and she will not say which.
people.subject: The moment: behind a dice table she tilts her head to show one ear, smiling kindly. Face: most important, the earrings: one large round pearl on a gold wire in each ear, and they differ by a faint hair's breadth in gloss, one bright and creamy, one slightly glassy and too perfect. A plump, soft, round, pink face with double chins; small, shrewd, bright eyes sunk in creases; thin plucked brows; a small nose; a small rosebud smile. Rouge sits in neat circles on both cheeks and her chins quiver as she tilts her head. Hair: white and grey, in a high round coil with a jade pin. Body: round, comfortable, short, with heavy, ring-laden hands. Clothing: a rich plum-coloured silk jacket with brocade at the collar and wide sleeves; a pale blue shawl; a necklace of coral beads; several gold rings. Hands and objects: a pair of small ivory dice cupped in her hand; a tray of coins. Her fat fingers curl delicately round the dice and a gold bracelet slides down her wrist. Background: a warm dim gaming room, lamplight, shadows of men leaning. Light: warm yellow from lamps at the lower right, cooler light from the upper left. Expression: a motherly, soft, rosebud smile with shrewd eyes that stay cold, a woman who will not say which pearl is real; a faint blue hint of water qi in the pearls.

people.imagined: A desert road at noon, the sand-worn face of a man who belongs to neither side. A sabre on each hip, one from his father's people, one from his mother's. He sits in the saddle without strain.
people.subject: The moment: on a camel in desert wind he looks steadily at the viewer, a sabre at each hip. Face: most important, the two sabres: a curved sabre with a red leather grip on his right hip and a straight-backed sabre with a black leather grip on his left, both fully visible, different in length. A long, lean, brown face worn smooth as stone by sand; narrow, pale hazel eyes in permanent squint; thin dark brows; a straight nose; a calm, level mouth; a short grey-black beard. Fine sand has settled into every line of his face. Hair: black, under a pale tan head-cloth wound round the head and neck. Body: wiry, bow-legged, easy in the saddle. Clothing: a sand-coloured robe with a high collar and a short dark vest; a red sash; leather riding boots; a long scarf of faded indigo. Hands and objects: the reins in one hand; the other loosely on the thigh. Background: bright sand dunes and pale blue sky, a smear of heat. A caravan line of small dark camels crawls over a far dune. Light: bright hard light from the upper left. Expression: a temperate, just, brave stillness, the squinting eyes calm and the mouth level, a man who belongs to neither side and sits the saddle without strain; a faint warm earth-gold and red hint of earth and fire qi.

people.imagined: The ice market at Quy Điểu Trấn. He sells live beasts and cores, and the lynx at his heel watches the crowd for him. The string of wolf teeth lies in his pocket now, because he no longer wears it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a market on ice, he looks sidelong with narrowed eyes, a grey lynx at his boot. Face: most important, the lynx: a grey spirit lynx with black ear tufts, sitting at his left heel and staring at the viewer, large in the frame. A lean, hard, handsome face with sharp cheekbones; cold, pale green eyes; thin straight brows; a narrow nose; thin lips set in a calculating line; a trimmed pale beard. Hair: sandy-brown, tied back, under a white fox-fur hood. Body: lean, wiry, standing alert. His back is very straight and he holds his elbows close, like a man ready to move at once. Clothing: a white fox-fur cape with the tails hanging, over a pale grey wool coat; leather gloves; a belt of linked bone beads; boots lined with fur; a pocket from which a few ivory teeth poke out. Hands and objects: one hand in the glove holding a short leather lead; the other on the hilt of a knife. The lynx's lead is a thin braided strap wound twice round his wrist, and a short curved skinning knife with a bone grip hangs in a sheath at his hip. Background: a blurred ice market with stalls and cages, grey sky. Light: cold white light from the upper left. The white fur of the cape glows bluish in the shade, and the lynx's tufted ears are tipped by sharp light. Expression: Narrowed, sidelong eyes with a cruel little curl of the lip and a suspicious tilt of the head, greed and mistrust in one hard look. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: Stairs to a ruin, a smile and two map cases. He stops on every stair to catch his breath, and his clients carry the cases on. The case he never opens hangs on the left shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: pausing on a stone stair, smiling warmly at the viewer, one hand on his chest. Face: most important, the two map cases: two long leather map cases, one hanging on each shoulder, one bright and new and one dark, worn and tied shut with a cord, both visible. A round, gentle, pleasant face with soft cheeks; warm brown eyes crinkled; thin neat brows; a small nose; a wide, easy smile; ink-stained fingers. Hair: black, thinning, in a tidy topknot. Body: soft, middling height, slightly out of breath. His chest rises and falls and his knees are slightly bent, a little sweat shining on his temple. Clothing: a scholar's grey robe with wide sleeves and a crossed collar, tidy but dusty; a black cord belt; ink on every fingertip; soft cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the left hand on the chest; the right hand holding a folding fan; ink-stained fingers. The fan is plain paper with only a faint brush wash of grey hills and no marks of writing, and the two map cases hang with the unopened one, black and cord-tied, on his left. Background: a stone stair rising into hanging mist, a half-hidden ruin gate. Light: soft misty light from the upper left. A pale mist softens the steps below him into a faint white slope. Expression: deceitful, friendly, easy. A faint green and grey hint of wood and metal qi.

people.imagined: The fish ponds of Ngư Đàm Thôn at dusk. She kneels at the pond edge, her dead husband's undyed sash tied round her waist, her hand in the water. Her daughter is not to sit the Frost Test.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a pond edge she lifts a wet hand from the water and looks at the viewer with set jaw. Face: most important, the sash and the silver: the undyed pale sash tied round her waist, rough and plain against dark clothes, and fish-scale silver glittering along both sleeves. A small, brown, lined face; dark, steady, stubborn eyes; thick straight brows; a small nose; a firm, small mouth. Hair: black with grey, in a tight bun under a faded blue cloth. Body: small, sturdy, kneeling upright. She kneels square on a flat stone, knees apart, back straight, her wet sleeve dark to the elbow. Clothing: a dark blue cotton jacket with the sleeves wet and silver with scales; a long grey skirt; an apron; the pale undyed sash. Hands and objects: a wet hand held up, dripping; a basket of small fish beside her. Four silver minnows hang in a small basket woven of reeds, and the pond water drips from her fingers in a bright thread. Background: a still dark pond, reeds, orange dusk. Light: low orange dusk light from the upper left. The orange dusk glows along the water and her damp hair, and the silver on her sleeves sparkles. Expression: A set, stubborn jaw and wet, steady eyes on the viewer, tenderness showing at the edges of a fierce, protective face. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: Against a dead wall in a ruin, his head tilted like a dog's, a silk strip on his wrist that stirs when nothing else does. The draught of a buried hall comes through the rock.
people.subject: The moment: pressed close to a stone wall he tilts his head sideways, listening, eyes unfocused. Face: most important, the silk strip: a thin pale-green silk strip tied round his left wrist, floating out sideways in the still air while everything else hangs limp, in the foreground. A long, thin, boyish face; large pale eyes with a faint silver sheen; thin arched brows; a long nose; a half-open mouth. His lashes are long and nearly white and a thin pulse beats at his temple. Hair: light brown, long and untidy, blown up and sideways at one side only. Body: tall, gangly, long-necked, leaning. His shoulders are narrow and slightly hunched, and his ribcage shows a little under the thin jacket. Clothing: a plain grey-blue cotton jacket with long sleeves; a rope belt; a kerchief at the neck; trousers; felt boots. The kerchief at his neck is knotted twice and tucked neatly into the collar. Hands and objects: the left hand flat on the stone, the wrist strip floating. The silk strip is a hand long and the colour of young leaves, and the fingers of his hand spread flat against the stone are long and pale. Background: a wet dark stone wall, a dim ruin, dust motes drifting. Light: dim cool light from the upper left. Dust motes hang around his head, drifting sideways in the unseen draught. Expression: an uncanny, curious, unfocused attention, the half-open mouth slack and the pale eyes unseeing; a faint pale-silver hint of wind qi stirring the strip and his hair.

people.imagined: A ridge camp in the mist. He is named for the three axe-scars across his cheek. He stares at the viewer with the stare of a man who has taught a village the new rate.
people.subject: The moment: in a misty camp he stands close to the viewer and stares, head tilted slightly forward. Face: most important, the three scars: three parallel pale white scars slanting across the left cheek from the cheekbone down to the jaw, thick and ridged, large and sharp in the frame. A heavy, square, tanned face; hard, dark, flat eyes; thick black brows; a broken nose; a thick lip curled in a faint sneer; a short black beard. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot with a leather cord. Body: thick, strong, broad-shouldered, stonecutter's forearms. He stands with his chest pushed forward and his chin lowered, as if about to move on the viewer. Clothing: a dark-brown leather coat with iron studs over a grey tunic; a fur collar; a wide belt with a short axe; fingerless gloves. Hands and objects: a short bearded axe held loosely down at his side in the right hand. The axe's blade has a small chip on its edge and a strip of red cloth wrapped round the haft above his fist; his knuckles on that hand are flat and broken. Background: grey mist, black pine trunks, a smoky fire. Light: cold grey light from the upper left, a dull orange glow from a fire. Mist dulls the light so the scars alone shine, like white tape across his dark cheek. Expression: A hard, close stare with the head tipped forward, brows low, the scarred cheek tight and the mouth impatient and without mercy. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: The Bobtail ridge, at the milestone. He has trimmed his own hair with a knife and leaves a bowl of rice each month; he wonders if the mist would take him as it took the others.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a stone milestone he sets down a small rice bowl and glances back with a worried face. Face: most important, the ears and the bowl-cut: large ears sticking straight out from the head like open doors, and an uneven bowl-shaped haircut, chopped straight across with a knife. A thin, young, boyish, nervous face; large dark brown eyes; thin, worried brows; a small nose; a small mouth tight. His ears are pink at the tips and a tiny freckle sits on his lip. Hair: dull black, bowl-cut, uneven. Body: thin, gangly, crouching. He crouches with his knees apart and his elbows resting on them, poised to run. Clothing: a too-big brown wool jacket with rolled sleeves; a rope belt with a knife; plain trousers; a grey wool scarf; a rough lynx-fur strip at the shoulder as a badge. Hands and objects: a small chipped bowl of white rice; the other hand on the milestone. The milestone is a rough grey pillar, knee-high and mossy, with a hollow on top where an older bowl has left a ring; his knife hangs from a cord, its blade shorter than his hand. The grains of rice are placed in a neat mound, the one tidy thing about him. Background: a mossy stone marker, misty trees, gloom. Light: cool grey mist light from the upper left. The mist makes his ears glow slightly pink at their edges. Expression: a humble, anxious, wary look glancing back, a boy who wishes he could leave and does not; a faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A river crossing at night with bales of hemp. He shorts each bale by a fifth. Hemp fibre has greyed his stubble, and rope burns circle both wrists like bracelets.
people.subject: The moment: crouched over a bale in the dark, he looks up with a calm, almost bored smile. Face: most important, the wrists: a ring of red-brown rope-burn scar circling each wrist like a bracelet, held on the bale in the foreground, and grey hemp fibres in the stubble of his chin. A narrow, calm, pale-brown face; heavy-lidded, quiet, grey eyes; thin, straight brows; a long nose; a thin, closed, faintly smiling mouth. Faint grey dust frosts his lashes. Hair: dark brown, tied at the nape, with fibres caught in it. Body: lean, wiry, crouched. He keeps his weight low and his shoulders loose like a man ready to slip away. Clothing: a dark blue hemp jacket with rolled sleeves; a leather belt with coils of cord; trousers wet to the knee; boots. The jacket is clean, dark and tightly stitched, a river trader's good cloth. Hands and objects: a heavy bale of pale hemp under his hands, tied with three loops of cord, one corner split open, showing pale grey-gold fibres; a short hooked knife lies on his knee. Background: a dark river bank, a shadowy boat, a faint lantern far off. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left. A faint cold line of moonlight runs along the cord and the stubble on his chin. Expression: a calm, almost bored, thin smile with heavy-lidded eyes, a man who shorts every bale by a fifth and is not troubled by it; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A river sandbank. She swirls the pan and her one gold tooth catches light; she says she found it. Her hands are bleached wrinkled, and her husband's ledger sits in the false bottom of the pan.
people.subject: The moment: in a shallow river she holds a wide flat wooden pan at her waist, smiling slightly as she swirls it. Face: most important, the hands and the tooth: both hands bleached white and wrinkled like a drowned person's, gripping the rim of the pan in the foreground, and a single gold tooth glinting in a half-smile. A weathered, round, brown face; narrow bright black eyes; thin brows; a flat nose; a mouth with one gold tooth. Hair: grey-black, in a tight bun under a bleached cloth. Body: short, solid, standing calf-deep. Her feet are planted wide apart in the stream, knees slightly bent, and water swirls round her calves. Clothing: a brown cotton blouse with sleeves rolled; a wet blue skirt kilted up; a leather apron; a shell necklace. Hands and objects: a wooden gold-washing pan with a thin film of water and dark sand, a few glints of gold. In the pan a thin swirl of dark sand sits with three tiny bright flecks of gold, and a second pan hangs from her belt on a rope, with a false bottom just visible as a seam. Background: a sunlit river and gravel bank. Light: bright clear light from the upper left, water glitter. The sun glints on the water and on the gold tooth, like a small star in her mouth. Expression: A slight, secret smile with cautious, pale-lidded eyes, the gold tooth just showing and her glance sliding to the pan. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A frost-coast quay, with ice-fish crates. His left eye wanders when he lies, which is often; he smells of brine and does not meet the eye.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a crate of ice-fish he gives the viewer a flat, reasonable smile, the left eye drifting. Face: most important, the wandering eye: the left eye turned noticeably outward and upward, looking off to the side while the right eye stares directly at the viewer, plainly mismatched. A wide, pale, fleshy, damp face; small, pale-blue eyes; sparse light brows; a thick nose; thin lips; stubble. Fine sweat beads his upper lip even in the cold. Hair: sparse grey-brown strands slicked across the scalp. Body: stout, thick, with a stoop. His belly rests on the edge of the crate, his stance slumped, one hip cocked. Clothing: a heavy dark oilskin coat shining with brine; a rope belt; fish-scale-stained trousers; a sealskin cap. Hands and objects: a silver ice-fish held by the tail in one hand; a flat crate behind him. The silver ice-fish he holds has a swollen belly stitched shut with black thread, and the crate beside him is stamped with a plain painted circle, nothing written. His fingers are thick and short, the nails pale with brine. Background: grey quay, stacked crates, boats, a thin mist. Light: cold flat light from the upper left makes the brine on his coat shine like a layer of glaze. Expression: a flat, reasonable, callous smile with one eye wandering off to the side, a man who does not meet your gaze when he lies; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The Pavilion's dead hall, cutting ice. He rubs a blue-grey frostbitten ear when he thinks, three solstice nights spent on the mere behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in an ice passage with a long ice saw over one shoulder he rubs his right ear thoughtfully. Face: most important, the ear: the right ear is blue-grey and waxy with an old frostbite patch, big and clear as his hand rubs it. A broad, patient, dark, weathered face; thick brows; small, calm, grey eyes; a flat nose; a stubborn mouth; stubble. Hair: black, short, a knitted cap hanging off. Body: huge shoulders broad as a door, thick neck, standing wide. His neck is thick and his arms hang slightly out from his sides, from the width of his back. Clothing: a heavy dark wool coat with the sleeves rolled; a quilted vest; leather gloves hanging at the belt; a rope round the waist; boots with cleats. Hands and objects: a long toothed ice saw over the left shoulder. The saw has a long blade with big triangular teeth and a wooden crossbar handle, and the rope round his waist is tied in a heavy knot with a spare coil at the hip. Background: blue ice wall, a lamp, tools. Light: cold blue from the upper left, a faint yellow lamp. The yellow lamp casts a faint glint along the saw teeth and the frost patch on his ear. Expression: A slow, thoughtful frown with the head slightly bowed, patient stubborn eyes and a humble, quiet mouth. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A dice house, late. He chews his thumbnail; the candle at his table gutters whatever the draught. He has lost for forty years and still hopes.
people.subject: The moment: at a dice table he chews the thumbnail of his raised right hand and looks at the viewer with pleading eyes. Face: most important, the guttering candle: a short thick candle on the table in front of him with a tall flame leaning sharply to one side and dripping wax, though other candles burn straight, in the foreground. A soft, round, flushed face with loose cheeks; damp, wide, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short nose; a trembling mouth. Hair: thin, grey-brown, combed over. Body: soft and round, hunched. His shoulders slump forward, his belly sits in his lap, and his left hand drums on the table edge. Clothing: a rumpled plum robe with food stains; a loose belt; a gambler's lucky coin on a string at the neck; sleeves stained with wine. Hands and objects: the chewed thumb; a small cup of dice. On the table are two small bone dice, a few lonely copper coins, and a spilled cup of wine, and the guttering flame has dripped a long white tongue of wax. Background: a dim dice house, a green felt table, blurred shapes. Light: warm yellow from the candle at the lower right. The candle's small light flickers on his damp cheeks and the sweat on his lip. Expression: indulgent, anxious, hopeful. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A reed-lined river in grey light. She stands in the ferry's bow, barefoot, braid tied with a fish-hook, remembering faces that were told to be forgotten.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot in a narrow boat's bow, a pole in her hands, she looks over her shoulder with a frown of effort. Face: most important, the fish-hook: a small bright fish-hook tying off the end of her long braid, dangling over her shoulder in the foreground. A small, round, reed-tanned face; large, clear, light-brown eyes; thin straight brows; a short nose; a determined mouth. A few water drops cling to her lashes. Hair: dark brown, in a long braid tied with a hook. Strands of damp hair stick to her neck. Body: slim, long-legged, balanced. She stands with her feet one before the other on the wet planks, knees bent to the boat's sway. Clothing: a short blue hemp tunic and trousers rolled to the knee, clean; a rope belt; bare arms and feet; a reed cord at the neck. Hands and objects: a long wooden pole in both hands; a cracked clay lamp-cup at her feet. The pole is pale wood with a notched grip, and the clay lamp-cup at her feet has a hairline crack and a thumbprint of soot, unlit. Background: tall reeds, a still river, mist. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. Faint grey light on the water throws pale reflections up under her chin. Expression: a brave, honest, haunted look, the clear eyes fixed on the far bank as if reading faces she was told to forget; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The apes' ridge, ginseng dug from the soil. Seamed like the roots she sells, with soil under every nail. She holds up one and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in forest earth she holds up a freshly dug forked ginseng root in a dirt-black hand. Face: most important, the seamed face: skin deeply lined all over in tight brown creases like the wrinkles of a dried root, and black soil packed under every nail on the held-up hand. A small, brown, deeply creased face; small, dark, wary eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a tight line of a mouth. Dirt is ground into the creases beside her nose and mouth. Hair: grey and wiry, in a tight bun under a faded green cloth. Body: small, bent, tough. Her back is bowed and her shoulders pulled forward, the posture of a person always bending to the ground. Clothing: a faded brown cotton jacket and trousers; a rope belt with a small digging bone-tool; a sack on her back; earth-dark knees. Hands and objects: a pale forked ginseng root with fine whiskers, in the right hand; a short bone spade in the left. The root has a long pale body with three fingers and a hair-fine beard; the soil on her wrist and on the sack's mouth is dark and damp, and a few red berries lie scattered nearby. Her nails are black-rimmed and her wrist bones stand out. Background: dark moss and ferns, grey mist. Light: dim green forest light from the upper left. The green light gives her skin a slight olive cast, and a thread of mist crosses behind her head. Expression: a flat, wary, diligent stillness, the small dark eyes not meeting yours, a woman who holds up the root and says nothing; a faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: The Loose Table under the pines, the stove going. She tucks a fresh pine needle behind her ear without noticing, and the foundation pills in the jar behind her come with no promise.
people.subject: The moment: behind a counter she ladles wine from a jar, beaming, a green pine needle tucked behind her right ear. Face: most important, the pine needle: a long green pine needle tucked behind her ear, bright against grey hair, and a face flushed red from the stove. A round, flushed, cheerful face with dimples; warm, bright, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short nose; a big smile. Hair: grey, in a loose bun with loose curls. Body: round, strong, comfortable. She stands with one hip against the counter, her shoulders shaking as she laughs. Clothing: a dark red cotton jacket with the sleeves rolled; a white apron with wine stains; a green kerchief at the neck; a belt with keys. Hands and objects: a wooden ladle; a jar of dark wine; a small stoppered clay jar on the shelf behind. The ladle drips a thin dark ribbon of wine back into the jar, and behind her a row of small clay jars with wax-sealed necks stand on a plank, all identical, one set apart. Background: a wooden counter, a stove with glowing coals, hanging jugs, a long table. Light: warm orange from the stove at the lower right, daylight from the left. The stove's glow turns her flushed cheeks a deeper red and lights the steam rising from the jar. Expression: gregarious, generous, pragmatic. A faint green hint of wood qi and a faint warm red from the stove.

people.imagined: A desert caravan at night; she sets out to sit the solstice test uninvited. Hair so black it looks wet; she does not blink in the wind.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a camel's pack in blowing sand, she looks straight ahead without blinking. Face: most important, the hair and the eyes: hair so black it gleams like wet ink, and wide dark eyes fixed open, unblinking in the wind. A small, fine, pale-gold face with a clear forehead; straight black brows; a small straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a sheen of dew-like frost on her lashes. Hair: pure glossy black, long and straight, blowing sideways. Body: slight, sitting very straight. She sits with her knees together and her back as straight as a post, the camel's hump swaying behind her. Clothing: a clean pale-blue cotton robe with a crossed collar under a sand-coloured travelling cloak; a veil at the neck; a plain sash. Hands and objects: a small jade-green water gourd in her lap; her hands folded. The gourd is the size of a fist with a braided green cord, and a faint dew of moisture clings to its side despite the dry air. Background: a dark blue desert night with stars and wind-driven sand. Light: pale starlight from the upper left. Fine sand streaks past in the starlight, and the only thing not blurred is the glimmer on her hair. Expression: ambitious, brave, set. A clear faint blue hint of water qi, a surprising frost, around her.

people.imagined: The bell foundry at Đà Linh Trấn. Brass dust on his forearms; he tilts his head so the half-deaf ear faces the clanging. He left the riders the opposite way to his grandmother's brother.
people.subject: The moment: in a foundry he holds a small camel bell up near his half-deaf ear and shakes it lazily, smiling. Face: most important, the brass dust: forearms and hands glittering with gold-brass dust, held up at the bell in the foreground. A broad, easy, brown face with a lazy half-smile; calm brown eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; sunburnt cheeks. Hair: black, tied in a short tail with a leather strip; one ear covered. Body: broad, relaxed, a little round. He stands with his weight on one hip, belly soft over the belt, his head tilted toward the good ear. Clothing: a plain sand-coloured cotton shirt with sleeves rolled; a leather apron smudged with brass; a sash; sandals. Hands and objects: a small brass camel bell; a string of finished bells on a hook beside him. A brass bell the size of a plum, with a clapper of black iron, is in his palm; a row of six larger bells hangs from a hook, each a slightly different shade of gold. Past the left shoulder rises the tan-corded hilt of a plain narrow straight sword slung on the back, its ochre-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of plain grey steel. Background: a foundry with a small furnace glowing orange, a rack of moulds. Light: orange from the furnace on the right, daylight from the upper left. The furnace glow makes the brass dust on his forearm sparkle like sequins. Expression: peaceable, easy, lazy. A faint earth-yellow and red hint of earth and fire qi.

people.imagined: A caravan inn table. He tells the Desert Road War for his supper in a cracked voice that carries no further than the next table; the dogs sleep through it.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an inn table, mouth open mid-sentence, one thin hand lifted in a storytelling gesture. Face: most important, the head: a bald crown, shiny and pink, ringed by a fringe of long grey hair falling to the shoulders. A thin, sunken, lined face with kind, watery, light eyes; bushy grey brows; a large nose; a wide mouth with few teeth open in speech. A thread of spittle shines at the corner of his lip as he speaks. Hair: the long grey fringe is combed straight and tucked behind the ears, the crown bare and freckled by the sun. Body: thin and bent, with a bony frame. His shoulders are bony and his neck long, and he leans forward on his forearms, as if to share a secret. Clothing: a plain brown robe, clean and carefully mended at the elbows, a storyteller who sings for his supper yet keeps himself tidy; a faded blue scarf; a rope belt; a small leather purse. Hands and objects: the lifted hand with a pinch of five coloured sands between finger and thumb (five small stripes of colour); a wooden bowl of soup on the table. Five tiny stripes of sand, red, blue, yellow, white and black, rest in a line on his palm; the soup bowl is chipped, and a sleeping dog's flank shows at the frame's edge. Background: an inn with lamps, sleeping dogs on the floor, dim figures. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the lower right. The lamp light picks out each long grey hair and the sheen on his bald crown. Expression: a gregarious, humble, hopeful eagerness with watery eyes and the wide mouth mid-word; a faint hint of five colours in the sand.

people.imagined: A snowed-in trapper's hut. The sables have long been trapped out, yet he runs his lines. He raises his gloves, fingers worn through, to warm them at the stove.
people.subject: The moment: seated by a stove he holds up both hands in worn sable gloves toward the heat, glancing at the viewer. Face: most important, the nose and the gloves: a nose that has been broken twice, crooked and swollen and red with cold, and a pair of dark sable gloves with all the fingertips worn through, pink fingers poking out. A long, weathered, bony face; pale, kind, tired eyes; thick grey brows; a grey stubble; a sunken mouth. Frost has melted in drops along his brows. Hair: white, thin, under a fur hat with ear flaps. A few white strands curl out from under the ear-flaps. Body: tall, thin, stooped. He sits with his shoulders hunched to his ears and his knees apart, the very picture of a man warming through. Clothing: a thick brown fur-trimmed coat with mended elbows; a heavy scarf; a belt with a skinning knife; felt boots. Hands and objects: the open gloves; a trap hung on the wall behind him. A string of old rusted traps hangs on the wall behind him with a single grey sable pelt, flat and worn; a mug of black tea sits on the stove's edge. Background: a dim wooden hut, a small iron stove glowing, hanging pelts. Light: warm orange from the stove on the right, cold light from the upper left. The orange stove glow warms his crooked nose, which looks even redder than the cold had left it. Expression: a tired, generous, reclusive gentleness, the pale eyes soft on the stove's glow, a trapper who still runs his lines; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The edge of the mirror forest at evening. He walks lost travellers out by the light, a white streak in his black hair that does not melt even by a fire.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a dark forest at dusk, a hand lifted to guide someone behind him, he looks back calmly. Face: most important, the white streak: a broad frost-white streak running back from his left temple through the black hair, with fine rime on it, shining. A calm, long, pale-bronze face; level dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, quiet mouth. A faint fog of breath hangs before his mouth. Hair: black and straight, falling loose to the shoulders and parted in the middle. Body: lean, tall, steady. He stands with one foot forward, shoulders open, in the easy stance of someone used to walking at night. Clothing: a dark blue-grey cotton coat with a fur collar; a leather belt with a small lantern; a scarf; leather gloves. The coat is well cut, its fur collar thick and clean, its cuffs closed with horn buttons. Hands and objects: the lifted hand; a pale small lantern of glass, glowing white. The glass lantern is the size of a pear and holds a cold white flame that casts no heat; a coil of pale cord hangs from his belt. Background: dark pines and a pale evening glow behind him, faint mist. Light: pale evening light from the upper left, a thin silver gleam on the white streak. Rime gleams on the white streak and on the lantern glass, and the forest behind him is nearly black. Expression: a calm, quiet, patient steadiness, the level eyes unhurried, a man who has walked many travellers out of the dark; a faint blue-white hint of frost qi.

people.imagined: A moonstone shaft. He rolls up a sleeve and the scar branches up his arm like a fern; the vein's lightning ran there, and woke Thunder in him at nine.
people.subject: The moment: in a mine shaft he rolls up his right sleeve and holds the arm out to the viewer, jaw set. Face: most important, the scar: a pale, branching, silver-pink scar like a fern or river delta, spreading up the right arm from the wrist to the shoulder, large across the frame. A square, strong, dust-pale face; hard, bright, dark eyes; thick, straight brows; a strong nose; a stubborn mouth; a faint stubble. Hair: black, short, dusted with pale grit. Body: strong, wide-shouldered. His right shoulder is a little lower than his left, the arm held a bit stiffly out from the body. Clothing: a dust-grey leather vest over a brown cotton shirt with one sleeve rolled; a belt with a pick; a leather cap hanging at the neck. Hands and objects: the scarred arm held out; in the left hand a lump of pale moonstone. The moonstone in his left hand is the size of a duck egg and pearly white, glowing faintly from within; the scar is darker at its branching tips. Background: a shaft lined with timber, the pale gleam of moonstone veins in dark rock. Light: cold white light from the upper left, a faint crackle of pale blue-white at the scar. A bluish flash of light runs faintly along the scar's lines, as if the vein were still passing. Expression: brave, impatient, proud. A faint violet-white hint of thunder qi along the scar.

people.imagined: The high ice above a hermitage gate, midsummer. Windburnt cheeks, her sleeves yellowed with snow-lotus pollen, she lifts a white bloom in a gloved hand.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a steep ice slope she holds up a snow-lotus bloom and smiles into the wind. Face: most important, the pink cheeks and the yellow sleeves: both cheeks bright pink and windburnt, and both sleeves stained bright yellow with pollen, in the foreground. A round, warm, kind face; clear, light, brown eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a wide, calm smile. Hair: brown, in two braids wound up under a white woolly hat. Body: sturdy, strong shoulders, leaning into the wind. Her knees are bent in the steep slope, her body leaning into the wind, her coat flapping behind. Clothing: a thick quilted pale blue jacket with yellow-stained sleeves; a grey wool scarf; leather gloves; a rope harness; boots with iron spikes. Hands and objects: a white, many-petalled snow-lotus with a yellow centre in the right hand; a small ice axe in the left. The snow-lotus has twelve white petals with a gold centre dusted with yellow pollen, and the rope harness round her waist ties to a peg driven into the ice. Background: a white ice slope, blue shadows, a distant roof. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left. The cold sun gives her cheeks a rosy glow and the flower a faint pearly shine. Expression: A calm, warm smile into the wind, windburnt cheeks lifted and eyes soft and generous. A faint blue-white hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A snow-jade mine. Her lashes are dusted pale with jade grit; she squints at a lamp as at a sun. She failed the Level Beam by five.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim mine she squints at a held-up lamp, her face turned half away. Face: most important, the lashes: both eyelashes and brows thickly dusted pale green-white with jade grit so her eyes look frosted, and her eyes squeezed nearly shut against the lamp. A thin, pale, serious face; fine features; a small straight nose; a patient, humble mouth. Hair: black, in a plain braid under a grey cloth cap. Body: slight, upright. She holds her elbows tight to her sides, her shoulders narrow, and stands as still as a post. Clothing: a grey-green dusted jacket of padded cotton; a leather apron; sleeves tied back; a small pouch of pale grit at the belt. Hands and objects: a miner's oil lamp held at arm's length; a lump of pale translucent snow-jade in the other hand. The snow-jade in her left hand is the size of a thumb and translucent, glowing a faint cool green; the lamp's chimney is soot-stained at the top. Background: a dark shaft, pale jade veins glowing faintly. Light: yellow lamplight from the right, cool jade-green light below. The lamp's yellow light and the jade's green light meet on her cheek in a soft pale blend. Expression: patient, devout, humble. A faint pale-gold and white hint of light and metal qi.

people.imagined: The charcoal village in daylight, her eyes wide against the glare; a woman in red has promised to come back and teach her. The soot in her knuckles never washes out.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a pale daylight yard she shades her widened eyes with a hand, blinking in the glare. Face: most important, the wide eyes: unusually large, very dark pupils that fill her eyes almost entirely in the daylight, and soot in every crease of the hand shading them. A thin, small, pale face; smudged cheekbones; faint brows; a small nose; a quiet, hopeful mouth. A little ash dusts one cheekbone. Hair: black, tied in a plain braid with a scrap of red cloth. Short wisps escape at her ears and temples. Body: slight, thin, upright. She stands with her shoulders drawn up, her feet together, shy and watchful. Clothing: a grey cotton dress, clean and mended at the hem, with the sleeves rolled; a leather apron; a rope belt; bare feet in clogs. Hands and objects: the soot-creased hand; a wicker basket of black charcoal at her feet. The charcoal in the basket is black and shiny, with one lump broken to show a silver grain; her shading hand has soot in each knuckle crease, as dark as pencil lines. Background: a bright yard with a smoking kiln dome and ash-grey trees. Light: bright overcast daylight from the upper left. Under her feet the shadows look slightly deeper than they should, pooling like spilled ink. Expression: a quiet, wondering, hopeful trust, the wide dark eyes lifted to the glare; a faint dark-violet hint of shadow qi gathering at her feet.

people.imagined: The old chief of the Bobtail robbers, who raised two nobodies' sons and hafted an axe in lynx bone for each. A memorial portrait showing him at the ridge fire, an old axe on his knee.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; an old man sits on a ridge by a fire, an axe across his lap. Face: most important, the two axes: two woodsmen's axes with pale lynx-bone hafts, one in his hands and one laid beside him, matching. A broad, kind, battered, weathered face; steady, gentle, dark eyes; thick white brows; a broken nose; a short white beard; a small smile. Hair: white, long, tied back, a lynx-fur cap with a tail. Body: broad, bulky, strong, sitting heavily. His shoulders are broad and rounded, and he sits with his knees wide apart, heavy and settled. Clothing: a thick brown wool coat with a lynx-pelt collar; a belt; fur gloves; heavy boots. Hands and objects: the two axes. Each axe has a haft of pale yellow-white lynx shin bone with a notch cut at the butt, and the blades are a dull dark iron with a faint chip near the edge. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a faint orange firelight and the shapes of pines. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, dark vignette. The faded orange firelight tints the lower half of his white beard the colour of old ivory. Expression: brave, generous, just. A faint green hint of wood qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 1171, the fire hall's door at Băng Hỏa Môn. A memorial portrait of the seal-cutter's boy turned digger, with a borrowed fire talisman held up and the ward's heat catching his coat.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a lean man stands holding a small square talisman of red paper before his chest. Face: most important, the red talisman: a square of bright red paper, the only strong colour, in his raised hand, with abstract gold strokes (not letters). A lean, eager, sun-browned face; bright, fearless, dark eyes; thick black brows; a wide mouth in a determined grin; a short beard. Hair: black, tied in a tail under a fur cap. Body: lean, wiry, slightly forward. He stands with his weight on the balls of his feet, his chest forward, as if just about to step through a door. Clothing: a frost-coast seal-fur coat, clean, with a quilted silk collar; mittens with the fingers cut; a belt with small carving knives and a seal-cutter's chisel. Hands and objects: the red talisman in the right; a small chisel in the left. Gold strokes on the red paper are swirling, abstract lines, nothing like writing; the chisel has a short bone handle polished by use. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a faint orange glow behind him. Light: soft light from the upper left, a hint of warm red at the paper, dark vignette. The warmth of the red paper tints his chin and the fur of his collar with a faint pink glow. Expression: brave, impatient, gregarious. A faint hot red hint of fire qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 1194, the sandstorm. A memorial portrait of the salt-boiler's son who felt nothing at the Frost Test three winters running and guarded salt caravans; he sits calm on a salt sack.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a quiet caravan guard sits on a sack of salt with his hands on his knees. Face: most important, the white salt dust: a fine pale dusting of white salt crystals on his dark hair, brows and shoulders, big and plain. A broad, plain, brown, kind face; calm, patient, dark eyes; thick straight brows; a flat nose; a mild, closed mouth; lines at the eyes. Hair: black, in a short tail under a pale head-cloth. Body: solid, broad, steady, sitting. His hands rest on his knees, his back is straight, and his shoulders are relaxed, the posture of a man at peace. Clothing: a sand-coloured cotton coat with a leather vest; a plain undyed sash tied at the waist; boots; a scarf over the mouth pulled down. Hands and objects: both hands resting open on his knees; a short curved sword in a plain scabbard at his hip. The salt sack is rough hemp, split along one seam so a trickle of white crystals spills; the short curved sword's scabbard is plain brown leather, with no ornament. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, faint wind-driven sand. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. A pale dust in the air catches the light like fine snow falling sideways. Expression: patient, content, honest. A faint blue hint of water qi, softened by the fade.
